events.name: Afrobeats Night Market

location.address: Ozumba Mbadiwe Ave, Victoria Island, Lagos
location.parkingNote: Ample parking • 5 min from Eko Hotel

events.description:
Afrobeats Night Market returns to Victoria Island for one unforgettable night under the sky. Expect back-to-back live sets, a curated food-and-drinks market and the best sound system in the city — all in one place.

Whether you're coming with your crew or flying solo, this is where Lagos comes to dance. Early sets kick off at 6PM, headliners take the stage from 9 and the vibe run till 2AM.
